scenarios.name: Reject unbound behavior changes
scenarios.given: a production or delivery behavior is changed
scenarios.when: the author runs the change-aware BDD check
scenarios.then: an updated scenario and a changed bound test method are required

manual.reason: The hosted main-branch ruleset requires readback from GitHub; offline test structure cannot establish the remote policy.
steps: Read the active Main branch ruleset and verify strict_required_status_checks_policy is true.
Verify exactly the existing core coverage, macOS build and iOS build checks remain required, with no bypass actors.
Integrate current main before merging older drafts; preserve the reviewed ruleset readback with acceptance evidence.

scenarios.name: Reject stale executable bindings
scenarios.given: a scenario names a test that was renamed or removed
scenarios.then: validation fails with the missing class and method

scenarios.name: Reject empty or skipped native runs
scenarios.given: a selected native command exits successfully without all bound tests passing
scenarios.when: the BDD runner reads its output
scenarios.then: the run fails rather than reporting scenario acceptance

scenarios.name: Accept passing unittest selectors across Python versions
scenarios.given: Python unittest reports a passing bound method
scenarios.when: verbose output names either its class or its class and method
scenarios.then: the exact passing selector is accepted in both formats

scenarios.name: Check PR changes against the current target branch
scenarios.given: a pull request includes changes already merged to its target since it was opened
scenarios.when: the CI behavior gate evaluates the pull request or a push
scenarios.then: the PR gate excludes already merged changes but rejects new unbound behavior, and pushes retain their before-commit comparison

scenarios.name: Keep generated Python bytecode out of candidate source status
scenarios.given: native tooling imports Python helpers while validating a release candidate
scenarios.when: the candidate source status is checked
scenarios.then: generated bytecode does not dirty the candidate but changed app code and new tooling source remain visible
